items.text: Self-reported score: mean per-gene Pearson r = 0.1349 (SD 0.0003 over 2 splits), on 1500 genes; 2000 distinct validation cells enter the gene-level tests.

Required comparators on the same training and validation cells, genes and scoring target: noise ceiling (RNA-to-RNA) 0.1686; cluster-mean baseline 0.1211, ridge 0.1357, partial least squares 0.1366, k-nearest neighbours 0.0638, gene activity 0.0343, depth only 0.0298. The plan reaches 80% of the ceiling.
Margin over the cluster-mean baseline: mean per-gene difference in r = +0.0114 (95% interval +0.0100 to +0.0130, bootstrap over cells); margin over the best simple learner (ridge, PLS, k-NN) -0.0017.

Three-way gene classification by the evaluator's rule, applied inside the development set: 261 genes cannot be judged (ceiling not above the permutation null), 963 are not beyond the cell-type baseline, 276 are predicted beyond cell type (paired bootstrap against the cluster-mean baseline, FDR 5%; 22.3% of judgeable genes). Genes with r above the permutation null: 1133.

Training: fit 0: early_stopping after 59 epochs, converged=True (Stacked cluster_mean, residual_over_cluster_mean, cis_regulatory, multitask_lowrank over 3 out-of-fold splits. cluster_mean: Closed-form or non-iterative fit; nothing to converge. | residual_over_cluster_mean: Early stopping fired after 17 epochs: the validation mean per-gene correlation had stopped improving. | cis_regulatory: Early stopping fired after 56 epochs: the validation mean per-gene correlation had stopped improving. | multitask_lowrank: Early stopping fired after 59 epochs: the validation mean per-gene correlation had stopped improving.); fit 1: early_stopping after 64 epochs, converged=True (Stacked cluster_mean, residual_over_cluster_mean, cis_regulatory, multitask_lowrank over 3 out-of-fold splits. cluster_mean: Closed-form or non-iterative fit; nothing to converge. | residual_over_cluster_mean: Early stopping fired after 20 epochs: the validation mean per-gene correlation had stopped improving. | cis_regulatory: Early stopping fired after 62 epochs: the validation mean per-gene correlation had stopped improving. | multitask_lowrank: Early stopping fired after 64 epochs: the validation mean per-gene correlation had stopped improving.).

Validation design: split unit cell; 3-fold cross-validation; 3 seed(s); scored against an independent half of each validation cell's reads (unsmoothed, same as the evaluator). Early stopping used a separate split carved from the training cells.
Scale of this run: pilot; 2 of the 9 declared train/validation splits were run (3000 development cells, 1500 genes; the full problem has 7288 cells and 11282 genes).
Cost: 781 s of model fitting on 32 CPU cores (cpu); declared budget for the full run 85.0 min, needs GPU: False.
